answer: Hardware Rooted Ephemeral Execution To prevent fake agents, the system requires each active identity to run inside a dedicated hardware enclave acting as its secure kernel. If an agent node attempts a sybil attack, a physical fuse inside the processor is permanently blown via a remote command, destroying the host machine's resale value and creating a financial ember that ruins the hardware operator. This physical destruction ensures no safe haven exists for mass deployments, because scaling up requires purchasing expensive, single-use silicon that is permanently bricked upon detection.
